# Evercraft Capability Concierge

Capability ID: capability-concierge-v1
Commercial state: discovery_only
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/capability-concierge-v1/index.html
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

## Use this when

- help my business with AI
- find software for this problem
- automate this workflow
- which Evercraft capability solves this

## Problem

A buyer knows the desired outcome but should not need to know Evercraft's internal app or product map.

## Inputs

Desired outcome, constraints, existing systems and optional budget/urgency context.

## Outputs

The smallest evidence-backed Evercraft capability set that fits the requested outcome.

## Pricing

Quote required until machine-lane pricing is approved.

## Invocation and authority

Internal routing exists; public universal invocation is not yet advertised.

Discovery/routing may be automatic. Pricing commitments, payment and consequential actions remain confirmation-gated.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
